name: lookup_book
description:
Look up a book in the library catalog.

Args:
    code: ISBN-13 of the book, thirteen digits such as 9780306406157.

Returns:
    The catalog record.

name: lookup_product
description:
Look up an item in the store inventory.

Args:
    code: Store SKU in the form AB-1234.

Returns:
    The inventory record.

name: lookup_paper
description:
Look up a published research paper.

Args:
    code: DOI of the paper, starting with '10.', such as 10.1038/nphys1170.

Returns:
    The paper's metadata.

name: cpu_stats
description:
Report processor load for a server.

Args:
    host: Hostname of the server.
    window_minutes: Averaging window in minutes: 1, 5 or 15.

Returns:
    Load average over the window.

name: memory_stats
description:
Report RAM consumption for a server.

Args:
    host: Hostname of the server.
    include_swap: Also report swap / page-file usage.

Returns:
    Used and free memory in MiB.

name: disk_stats
description:
Report storage use for a server.

Args:
    host: Hostname of the server.
    mount: Mount point or drive to inspect, such as /var or C:.

Returns:
    Used and free bytes on the mount.

name: send_email
description:
Deliver a written message to a person.

Args:
    recipient: Email address such as name@example.com.
    text: Message body.

Returns:
    Delivery id.

name: send_sms
description:
Deliver a short text message to a person's phone.

Args:
    recipient: Phone number in E.164 form such as +14155550123.
    text: Message body, at most 160 characters.

Returns:
    Delivery id.

name: post_message
description:
Post a message to a team chat space.

Args:
    recipient: Channel name beginning with '#', such as #ops.
    text: Message body.

Returns:
    Message permalink.

name: upload_file
description:
Copy a local file to cloud object storage.

Args:
    path: Local path of the file.
    bucket: Name of the S3 bucket to copy into.

Returns:
    Object URL.

name: attach_file
description:
Attach a file to a support ticket.

Args:
    path: Local path of the file.
    ticket_id: Ticket key such as SUP-1042.

Returns:
    Attachment id.

name: share_file
description:
Create a shareable download link for a file.

Args:
    path: Local path of the file.
    expires_hours: Hours until the link stops working.

Returns:
    The link.

name: create_event
description:
Add an entry to the shared calendar.

Args:
    title: Event title shown to attendees.
    start: ISO-8601 start time.
    attendees: Email addresses to invite.

Returns:
    Event id.

name: set_reminder
description:
Schedule a personal notification.

Args:
    text: What to remind about.
    at: ISO-8601 time at which the notification fires.

Returns:
    Reminder id.

name: block_focus_time
description:
Reserve uninterrupted time on your own schedule.

Args:
    start: ISO-8601 start time.
    duration_minutes: Length of the block in minutes.
    mute_notifications: Silence all notifications during the block.

Returns:
    Block id.

name: convert_currency
description:
Convert an amount between currencies.

Args:
    amount: Amount to convert.
    source: ISO 4217 code of the source, such as EUR.
    target: ISO 4217 code of the target, such as JPY.

Returns:
    Converted amount.

name: convert_units
description:
Convert a measurement between units.

Args:
    amount: Value to convert.
    source: Unit symbol of the source, such as km, lb or degF.
    target: Unit symbol of the target.

Returns:
    Converted value.

name: convert_timezone
description:
Convert a clock time between time zones.

Args:
    amount: Clock time to convert, such as 14:30.
    source: IANA zone name of the source, such as Europe/Paris.
    target: IANA zone name of the target.

Returns:
    Converted clock time.
